name: TLP250H(F)
title: TLP250H, TLP250HF: photocoupler gate driver, ±2.5 A totem-pole output, 10 V to 30 V, DIP8
summary: An optically isolated driver for the gates of IGBTs and power MOSFETs. An infrared GaAlAs LED on the input side shines on a high-gain detector IC with a totem-pole MOSFET output that both sources and sinks up to 2.5 A peak. The detector side runs from 10 V to 30 V, has undervoltage lockout near 8.5 V, and a Faraday shield gives at least ±40 kV/µs common-mode transient immunity. Ratings hold from -40 °C to 125 °C. TLP250H has 7.62 mm lead rows and 7 mm creepage; TLP250HF has 10.16 mm rows and 8 mm creepage; both are isolated to 3750 Vrms.

circuits.title: IOPH test circuit
circuits.description: Peak source current of the output in its high state. A 5 mA current source lights the LED. VCC is applied with its positive side, pin 8, at ground, so pin 5 sits at -VCC; 0.1 µF bypasses pins 8 to 5. A source V8-6 in series with an ammeter runs from pin 8 to pin 6 and pulls VO a fixed step below VCC while the ammeter reads IOPH.

circuits.title: IOPL test circuit
circuits.description: Peak sink current of the output in its low state. The LED pins are open, so the output is low. VCC feeds pin 8 against grounded pin 5 with 0.1 µF across them. A source V6-5 in series with an ammeter holds pin 6 a fixed voltage above pin 5 while the ammeter reads IOPL.

circuits.title: VOH test circuit
circuits.description: High output level under load from split supplies. 5 mA lights the LED. VCC1 (+15 V) feeds pin 8 and VEE1 (-15 V) feeds pin 5, both against ground, with 0.1 µF from pin 8 to pin 5. A 200 Ω load runs from VO to ground and a voltmeter reads VO against ground.

circuits.title: VOL test circuit
circuits.description: Low output level under load from split supplies. A 0.8 V source across the LED holds it below its threshold, so the output is low. VCC1 (+15 V) and VEE1 (-15 V) feed pins 8 and 5 against ground with 0.1 µF between them; 200 Ω loads VO to ground and a voltmeter reads VO.

circuits.title: ICCH test circuit
circuits.description: Supply current with the output high and unloaded. 10 mA lights the LED; VCC = 30 V reaches pin 8 through an ammeter, pin 5 is ground, 0.1 µF sits from pin 8 to pin 5 and VO is open.

circuits.title: ICCL test circuit
circuits.description: Supply current with the output low and unloaded. The LED pins are open; VCC = 30 V reaches pin 8 through an ammeter, pin 5 is ground, 0.1 µF sits from pin 8 to pin 5 and VO is open.

circuits.title: Switching time test circuit
circuits.description: Propagation delays and output edges into a gate-like load. A pulse generator drives the anode with 10 mA pulses at 250 kHz, 50 % duty, edges of 5 ns or less; the cathode returns to ground through RIN = 100 Ω, and the voltage on RIN is the LED current monitor. VCC feeds pin 8 with 0.1 µF to pin 5 at ground. VO drives Rg = 20 Ω in series with Cg = 10 nF to ground.

circuits.title: Common-mode transient immunity test circuit
circuits.description: A pulse generator VCM between the input-side ground and the output-side ground applies 1000 V common-mode edges. A switch picks the input state: at A the anode takes current from a battery through a series resistor and the LED is on; at B the anode is tied to the input ground and the LED is off. The cathode sits on the input ground. On the output side VCC feeds pin 8 with 0.1 µF to pin 5 and VO is watched: it must stay above 26 V with the LED on (CMH) and below 1 V with it off (CML).

operation.text: A GaAlAs infrared LED between pins 2 and 3 couples across the isolation gap to a photodiode and high-gain amplifier on the detector chip, with a Faraday shield between them. The amplifier drives a totem-pole pair of MOSFETs: M1 from VCC to VO and M2 from VO to GND. With the LED lit M1 conducts and VO goes high; with it dark M2 conducts and VO goes low, so the output follows the input without inversion.
For the on state the LED takes 6.5 mA to 10 mA with edges faster than 0.5 µs; the threshold is 5 mA at most. For the off state the voltage across it stays between 0 V and 0.8 V.
VCC runs from 10 V to 30 V. A 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor from pin 8 to pin 5, no more than 1 cm from either pin, is required for the amplifier to switch reliably. VCC must ramp at 3.0 V/µs or slower.
With the LED on, VO stays low until VCC rises past VUVLO+ (7.5 V to 9.5 V, 8.7 V typical) and drops low again when VCC falls below VUVLO- (8.4 V typical); the hysteresis is about 0.3 V.

The output's peak rating is 2.5 A both ways for exponential pulses no wider than 0.2 µs at up to 15 kHz from 20 V, or 0.08 µs at up to 25 kHz from 15 V. The recommended peak is 2.0 A. At 250 kHz the operating condition is exponential pulses of up to 0.65 A lasting 80 ns or less, at 125 °C and 20 V.
Above 110 °C ambient, LED forward current falls by 0.54 mA/°C, peak transient LED current by 25 mA/°C, input dissipation by 1.0 mW/°C and output dissipation by 2.0 mW/°C.

TLP250H, on 7.62 mm rows, has at least 7.0 mm creepage and clearance; TLP250HF, on 10.16 mm rows, has at least 8.0 mm. Insulation inside is at least 0.4 mm thick. Both withstand 3750 Vrms for 60 s, with pins 1 to 4 and pins 5 to 8 each shorted together.

Reflow is set by package surface temperature (Sn-Pb: 140 °C to 160 °C preheat for 60 s to 120 s, above 210 °C within 30 s, 240 °C peak; lead-free: 180 °C to 190 °C preheat for 60 s to 120 s, above 230 °C for 30 s to 50 s, 260 °C peak), once or twice, finishing within two weeks of the first pass. Flow soldering is done once: preheat to 150 °C package surface for 60 s to 120 s, then 260 °C for no more than 10 s. A soldering iron may heat each lead once, up to 260 °C for 10 s or up to 350 °C for 3 s.

Store at 5 °C to 35 °C and 45 % to 75 % relative humidity, away from moisture, sunlight, corrosive gas, dust, mechanical load and rapid temperature change, and in anti-static containers once out of the original packing. Leads of parts stored over two years should be checked for solderability before use.
